_comment: Table of contents for the documentation in docs/. This one file drives BOTH consumers:
the in-app Help screen (Grafida\Help\HelpService reads it) and the generated _Sidebar.md
on the GitHub wiki (scripts/sync-wiki.sh writes it). Adding a page means adding its .md
file here AND to this list — nothing is discovered by scanning, because glob() does not
work inside the compiled binary's phar.
A node is either a page, a heading, or a page that is also a heading:
slug     = the file name without .md, and the wiki page name. [A-Za-z0-9_-] only.
Omit it for a node that only groups others and has no page of its own.
title    = the label in the table of contents (the page's own H1 is what the page shows).
children = nested nodes, to a maximum depth of 4. Order is display order at every level.
The files themselves stay in ONE flat directory whatever the nesting says — the wiki has a
flat page namespace and cannot represent a folder, so the tree lives here and only here.
